messages:
aria: Quick sync — post-launch backlog wants a decision. We have 3 incoming signals: 1) customer A reporting embedding mismatch (regression), 2) requests for multi-turn context window increase, 3) a flaky telemetry exporter producing duplicate events.

aria: Goal: decide what goes into a 1-week hotfix vs next wave enhancements.

matt: Can we surface severity for each? my take: embedding regression = P0 (affects accuracy), telemetry duplicates = P1 (ops noise), context window = enhancement (P2).

sophia: +1 on severity. Embedding regression also has an easy repro attached to the customer ticket. linked it here: https://app.support/RED-2312

jordan: If embedding is P0, do we have a rollback candidate or quick model variant to fallback to?

aria: We do — model v2.1 was performing before last rollout. ops notes show it’s compatible with current infra. fallback would be a config change, not heavy infra work.

matt: So plan A: immediate revert to v2.1 for affected customers or global canary for 24h while we triage. Plan B: if revert not possible, ship a targeted patch (model weight fix) in the hotfix.

sophia: How many engineers for hotfix? I can take ownership on triage and PR review. Need someone from infra for the canary toggle (jordan?).

jordan: I can own the canary toggle and rollout rollback. ETA ~4h to prepare the toggle & dashboard (if we prioritize it).

aria: Telemetry duplicates — is there evidence customer impact? or only internal noise?

matt: Mostly internal, but it's spiking our alert volume and masking real errors. P1 but resolvable next sprint unless it spikes more.

sophia: Context window increase — design doc linked: https://docs.redwood/context-window-proposal. Needs kernel tuning + perf tests; not for hotfix. Recommend backlog and start spec work for wave+1.

aria: Proposal (vote):
- Hotfix (this week): embed regression mitigation via canary rollback -> owner: jordan + sophia (triage)
- Quick follow-up (next 2 weeks): targeted model patch if root cause identified -> owner: matt
- Backlog/enhancement (wave+1): context window work + perf tests -> owner: product
- Telemetry: schedule triage in tomorrow’s infra triage meeting; escalate if alert volume > 200/hr -> owner: eng-infra

matt: +1. recommend adding a CI smoke test for embedding diffs before rollout.

sophia: I'll add a minimal embedding regression check to the rollout checklist: diffs < 0.02 cosine on key tests.

aria: Cool. Jordan — can you create the canary toggle runbook and add to the release channel?

jordan: On it, will post a runnable checklist and ops dashboard link within 2h.

triage-bot: Reminder: create incident ticket if rollback > 15% of traffic or if customer SLA breached.

aria: Planning note: we should communicate to Customer A that we acknowledged and are rolling a conservative fix; assign a CS contact for updates. matt, can you draft message?

matt: Drafting now — will post to #customer-comm and flag CS.

aria: Final: moving embedding regression to P0 hotfix with canary rollback plan, telemetry to P1 backlog triage, context window to wave+1. Closing this thread after jordan posts runbook. :thumbsup:

matt: SG :thumbsup:

sophia: Thanks all — will update the checklist and open PR for the test.

jordan: Runbook posted: https://ops.redwood/canary-runbooks/1769234567

aria: Thanks — closing loop.
